args.sql:
SELECT vd.containvac, SUM(vd.vialtally) as total_vials, c.volliters 
FROM vaccinedetails vd 
JOIN container c ON vd.containvac = c.containregistry 
GROUP BY vd.containvac, c.volliters 
LIMIT 10;

SELECT containlink, AVG(tempdevcount) as avg_tempdev, AVG(critevents) as avg_critevents, AVG(tempstabidx) as avg_tempstab 
FROM sensordata 
GROUP BY containlink 
LIMIT 10;

WITH efficient_containers AS (
    SELECT c.containregistry,
           SUM(vd.vialtally) * 10.0 / c.volliters AS ser,
           (1 - AVG(sd.tempdevcount)::numeric/100) * (1 - AVG(sd.critevents)::numeric/10) * AVG(sd.tempstabidx) AS tss
    FROM container c
    JOIN vaccinedetails vd ON vd.containvac = c.containregistry
    JOIN sensordata sd ON sd.containlink = c.containregistry
    WHERE c.containflag = 'Active'
    GROUP BY c.containregistry, c.volliters
    HAVING SUM(vd.vialtally) * 10.0 / c.volliters > 0.8 
       AND (1 - AVG(sd.tempdevcount)::numeric/100) * (1 - AVG(sd.critevents)::numeric/10) * AVG(sd.tempstabidx) > 0.9
)
SELECT ec.containregistry, ec.ser, ec.tss
FROM efficient_containers ec
LIMIT 10;

WITH efficient_containers AS (
    SELECT c.containregistry
    FROM container c
    JOIN vaccinedetails vd ON vd.containvac = c.containregistry
    JOIN sensordata sd ON sd.containlink = c.containregistry
    WHERE c.containflag = 'Active'
    GROUP BY c.containregistry, c.volliters
    HAVING SUM(vd.vialtally) * 10.0 / c.volliters > 0.8 
       AND (1 - AVG(sd.tempdevcount)::numeric/100) * (1 - AVG(sd.critevents)::numeric/10) * AVG(sd.tempstabidx) > 0.9
)
UPDATE container c
SET containflag = 'Efficient'
FROM efficient_containers ec
WHERE c.containregistry = ec.containregistry;
